reviewer_role: Separate model-assisted audit agent with code-edit ownership separated from extractor author; not independent human certification.
checked_properties: Three-level nested tables partition every fact ordinal exactly once; outside-table facts, invalid numeric lexicals, and equal/nested occurrences are retained.
A fact in an inner table cannot inherit an outer table cell index; nearest-table caption ownership is retained.
XHTML namespace identity is prefix-independent, while foreign table local names do not become XHTML tables.
Nested-table content is excluded from parent text through inline wrappers; skipped comment/PI/script/style nodes preserve surrounding tails.
XML whitespace collapse preserves NBSP and em spaces; block separators preserve inline numeric-fragment concatenation.
Declared spans remain raw metadata; invalid spans do not become one; no grid expansion is inferred.
Every emitted authored anchor hashes exact original UTF-8 bytes, including self-closing nested tables.
Swapped same-value typed fact records and tampered anchor hashes are refused.
Private labels, captions, paragraphs, headers and quantities are absent from public inventory.
Direct and symlinked repository-contained private destinations are refused; public output cannot be mixed into the private directory.

findings.finding: execute() initially allowed private table JSONL inside the Git repository.
findings.resolution: Owner added resolved-path guards before protocol loading/extraction; direct and symlink regressions pass.

findings.finding: Three draft audit guard assertions guessed different error-message words.
findings.resolution: Assertions now check the documented ViewError type. Correct guards were already firing; this was an audit oracle issue.

findings.finding: Author proposed explicit block-child separators to prevent adjacent block text concatenation.
findings.resolution: Bounded syntactic rule documented before freeze and independently tested; no rendering or semantic claim follows.

findings.finding: Author added full-cohort expected denominator and per-source expected count before extraction.
findings.resolution: Final source hash includes this public-metadata safeguard; source is unchanged during the final 18-test run.

findings.finding: Author discovered built-in pyexpat can lack __file__ while constructing protocol before freeze.
findings.resolution: Runtime manifest now explicitly distinguishes built-in implementation backed by pinned interpreter from separately pinned extension. Independent review inspected the change, called runtime_bindings successfully, checked executable digest and reran all 18 adversarial tests.

limitations: Authored XML fixtures are not natural-source extraction, benchmark QA or financial accuracy evaluation.
Anchors reuse the frozen Expat helper; lxml supplies another DOM traversal. Not every anchoring step is independently implemented.
Source DOM order is not browser-validated layout, expanded grid, header interpretation or verified visibility.
Public/private tests exercise defined schemas and sentinel content; they are not a general third-party-content disclosure scanner.
No exhaustive fuzzing, HTML conformance validation, large-corpus performance test or financial-scope inference was performed.

pre_freeze_review_history.note: Prior review before author discovered built-in pyexpat runtime binding issue; no table extraction or protocol freeze had occurred.
